name: livro-studio
description: Editor desktop pessoal para escrita e diagramação de livros.

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node scripts/run-electron.cjs .
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.cjs scripts/smoke.cjs
scripts.benchmark: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc --ignoreConfig --outDir .tmp/benchmark --rootDir src --module Node16 --moduleResolution Node16 --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck src/domain/defaultDocument.ts src/domain/document.ts src/domain/pageGeometry.ts src/domain/textFormatting.ts src/domain/textStory.ts src/layout/layoutTypes.ts src/layout/pagination.ts src/layout/textMeasurement.ts src/persistence/documentCodec.ts && node scripts/benchmark.cjs
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
